excerpt.zh: 雪拉企业不会对任何客户抱有偏见。毕竟我们何德何能去对您的道德准则品头论足呢？
excerpt.en: We do not discriminate against prospective buyers here at XuraCorp. Who are we to judge the morals of your star nation?

texts.zh: 雪拉企业不会对任何客户抱有偏见。毕竟我们何德何能去对您的道德准则品头论足呢？
texts.en: We do not discriminate against prospective buyers here at XuraCorp. Who are we to judge the morals of your star nation?

texts.zh: 您可能需要矿物来建造战舰，或者用它们来建造孤儿院！在雪拉企业，我们绝不会过问您打算如何使用我们的商品！
texts.en: Perhaps you need minerals for building warships. Perhaps you need them for building orphanages! Here at XuraCorp, we make it our business not to care!

texts.zh: 我们绝不过问任何事情——我们只提供品质精良的物资，保证让您十分满意，时刻准备着为您的工业建设输送新鲜血液!
texts.en: No questions asked - just quality resources, ready to be pumped right into the arteries of your industry!

texts.zh: 恕不退款，十分抱歉。这是公司的政策……这超出了我们的[xuracorp_country.species.GetHandNamePlural]掌控的范围。
texts.en: No refunds, I'm afraid. Company policy... It's out of my [xuracorp_country.species.GetHandNamePlural].

texts.zh: 客官您对本公司的非品牌蒸馏装备感兴趣吗？并不？那么微粒检测器呢？
texts.en: Can we interest you in some off-brand distillation equipment? No? How about particulate detectors?

texts.zh: 欢迎联系雪拉企业，请问您需要什么服务呢？
texts.en: You have reached XuraCorp. How may we help you?

如果你改变心意的话请随时告诉我们！

Very well. We shall immediately transmit instructions to our freighters telling them to stand down and return to base.

Let us know if you change your mind!

texts.zh:
这是我们雪拉企业引以为傲的产品。我们的医疗部门最近开始精炼一种性质独特的气体，可以使适应外星环境的艰难过程变得轻松不少。不过它很可能无法与外星生理机能相容！

我们愿意在十个标准年里向你出口异星天然气，之后我们就必须重新签订协议。
texts.en:
This is a product that we here at XuraCorp are particularly proud of. Our Medical Division has recently begun refining a gas with unique properties that will significantly ease the often difficult process of adapting to a foreign planetary environment. It is however unlikely to be compatible with alien physiology!

We are willing to export our Exotic Gas to you for a period of ten standard years, after which the contract will have to be renegotiated.

texts.zh:
雪拉企业就该这样做生意啊！我们的货船会马上开始发货。

如果您购买了这个产品，也就等同于默认雪拉企业将不对使用这个产品所产生的任何副作用负责，这包括但不限于皮肤刺激，精神病发作，眼球变色，侵略性的突变，殖民地居民自杀率增加，预知恍惚，生物圈资源耗尽，高危奇异物质产生，微型黑洞生成，谷物升降机爆炸，社会崩溃，大规模灭绝事件，意外的超新星爆炸，局部或全面的星际帝国崩溃、突发的伽玛射线暴，时间旅行悖论，真空亚稳态事件，通用熵，时空连续性的崩溃……
texts.en:
That's the XuraCorp way! Our freighters will begin making deliveries immediately.

By purchasing this product, you agree that XuraCorp cannot be held responsible for any adverse effects that may result from its use, including but not limited to: skin irritation, psychotic episodes, ocular discoloration, aggressive mutation, increased colonist suicide rates, precognitive trances, biosphere depletion, dangerous strangelet production, micro black hole generation, grain elevator explosions, societal collapse, mass extinction events, unexpected supernova detonations, the complete or partial destruction of your star nation, sudden gamma-ray bursts, time travel paradoxes, vacuum metastability events, universal entropy, the collapse of the space-time continuum...

texts.zh: 亲爱的客户，我们很遗憾的通知你，我们同[Root.GetName]的异星天然气协定已经到期。如果你有多余的能量币，我们当然愿意再延长十年的交易…
texts.en: Dearest customer, we regret to inform you that the trade deal we negotiated for the export of Exotic Gas to the worlds of the [Root.GetName] has run its course. We are of course more than willing to extend the deal for another ten years if you have the energy credits to spare...

label.zh: 很好。我们希望延长这笔交易。
label.en: Very well. We wish to extend the deal.

label.zh: 我们对其他的东西有兴趣……
label.en: We were interested in something else...

label.zh: 我们现在用不着你们的气体了。
label.en: We can do without your gas for now.

texts.zh: 我们有一位才华横溢的执行经理随时待命，准备前往[Root.GetName]，解决您任何一片星域的困境。£trade£贸易额的事就交给专家来解决吧！
texts.en: We have a talented executive standing by, ready to migrate to the [Root.GetName] and get any of your sectors back out of the red. Entrust your £trade£ Trade to an expert!

texts.zh:
我们有一位才华横溢的高管随时待命，准备……嗯？你说什么？

“买方须知”很好，但是我还是有义务通知您，我们的顾问真的只专注于£trade£贸易额。我不确定这是否适合你，毕竟……您与这一概念似乎有些格格不入。
texts.en:
We have a talented executive standing by, ready to... Hm. Are you sure?

'Buyer beware' is all well and good, but still: I feel obliged to inform you that our consultants really only specialize in £trade£ Trade. I'm not sure they would be a good fit for you, given your... unusual relationship with that concept.

texts.zh:
这种易爆微粒是里甘的珍贵调味料。它以独一无二的味道在宇宙中声名远扬——它独一无二的爆炸性也同样声名远扬。我们只卖给最宝贵的贸易伙伴，[Root.GetName]便是其一。

只要你接受这合理的价格，我们愿意在十个标准年里向你出口易爆微粒。
texts.en:
The Volatile Mote is a prized Riggan condiment. It is renowned throughout the galaxy for its distinct flavor, which is unlike any other - and its explosiveness, which is also unlike any other. We sell it only to our most valued trading partners, among which we count the [Root.GetName].

If you can meet our modest price, we are willing to export Volatile Motes to you for a period of ten standard years.

texts.zh: 千年之前，穆塔根帝国从浩瀚星系之中汲取惊人财富，然而现在我们这个小小的财阀成了帝国的唯一遗产。
texts.en: Thousands of years ago, the Muutagan Empire spanned a good portion of the galaxy. We are all that remain.

texts.zh: 有传言穆塔根人可以敏锐地嗅到十二个秒差距以外的商机，这种说法实在是有些夸张了……说真的，最远只有八个秒差距而已。
texts.en: It is said that a Muutagan can smell a good deal from a distance of twelve parsecs. This is an exaggeration... In truth, the distance is only eight parsecs.

texts.zh: 穆塔根商人公会欢迎您，打算来一发交易吗？
texts.en: The Muutagan Merchant Guild welcomes you. Would you like to make a deal?

texts.zh: 一个穆塔根人和一个雷西达伦人一起走进一间酒吧……算了，当我没说，这么交流实在欠妥，请您原谅。
texts.en: A Muutagan and a Rixidaran walk into a bar... Never mind, this does not make for appropriate conversation. I beg your forgiveness.

texts.zh: 您好，[Root.GetSpeciesName]。您是来这里找我们交易的吗？

texts.zh:
史拉卡-杜——也被我族之外的人称为稀有水晶——已经成了我们整个文明的象征。当这些“歌唱”水晶震动时，会散发一种独特的旋律，可对大多数智慧生物起到镇静作用。

尽管我们通常不会与外人分享史拉卡杜的神奇，但可以为你开个特例。如果你付得起，我们愿意在十个标准年里向你出口我们的水晶。
texts.en:
Shi'rakkat-Du - or Rare Crystals as they are known to those who are not of our species - have come to symbolize our entire civilization. When these "singing" crystals vibrate, they emit a unique musical tone that has a calming effect on most sapients.

Although we typically do not share the wonders of the Shi'rakkat-Du with outsiders, we are willing to make an exception in your case. If you can afford it, we are willing to export our crystals to you for a period of ten years.

texts.zh: 时光易逝，不是吗，[Root.GetSpeciesName]？我们之间的稀有水晶贸易已经十年了。你希望再签署一个十年的贸易协定么？
texts.en: The years just fly by, don't they, [Root.GetSpeciesName]? It has now been ten years since we arranged our trade deal for Rare Crystals. Do you wish to extend the deal for another decade?

label.zh: 是的。让我们继续这个交易。
label.en: Yes. Let us continue this deal.

label.zh: 我们对其他的东西有兴趣……

label.zh: 我们现在不需要你们的水晶了。

texts.zh: 我们有一位才华横溢的执行经理随时待命，准备前往[Root.GetName]，解决您任何一片星域的困境。£trade£贸易额的事就交给专家来解决吧！
texts.en: We have a talented executive standing by, ready to migrate to the [Root.GetName] and get any of your sectors back out of the red. Entrust your £trade£ Trade to an expert!

texts.zh:
我们有一位才华横溢的高管随时待命，准备……嗯？你说什么？

“买方须知”很好，但是我还是有义务通知您，我们的顾问真的只专注于£trade£贸易额。我不确定这是否适合你，毕竟……您与这一概念似乎有些格格不入。
texts.en:
We have a talented executive standing by, ready to... Hm. Are you sure?

'Buyer beware' is all well and good, but still: I feel obliged to inform you that our consultants really only specialize in £trade£ Trade. I'm not sure they would be a good fit for you, given your... unusual relationship with that concept.
